name: mscse-4xxxx-yes-counts-outright
description: DGS 2026-10-03 (P1-levels-grades-credits-8: “They are the same. A yes is a pre-approval for MSCSE too. adgs_approval means the course may count after ADGS approval, for which a per-course tick box will be needed. Even with yes, 4xxxx/5xxxx courses are still subject to the allowance limit.”) — reversing the 2026-10-02 reading of §3.2’s “subject to approval by the advisor and the ADGS” as a per-student tick on every credit below the 60000 level. CSE 40113’s row says yes for the MSCSE, so it counts outright inside the six-credit allowance, with no tick; the advisor’s approval is the plan-of-study box. (As mscse-4xxxx-yes-needs-approval this fixture asserted the tick from 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-03.)

detailIncludes: 3 of the 6 credits below the 60000 level used
